name: Melanie Candy
story: Taranaki Regional Council’s Transforming Taranaki publication identifies Melanie Candy as a GIS officer updating a riparian plan. The account places her work in the council’s programme of mapping and planning streamside protection on farms. It documents a specific operational use of GIS without establishing a wider career chronology.
The council's November 2011 programme booklet shows Melanie Candy updating a riparian plan, with aerial mapping on screen and paper.
